topic_ko: 립스틱 효과 — 경기가 나빠도 사람들은 감당할 수 있는 작은 즐거움(립스틱·향수)을 산다

passage: When the economy slows down, many people cut back on big purchases.
They spend less money on expensive products such as designer bags.
Yet they do not stop treating themselves completely.
Instead, they spend a little on small luxuries such as a lipstick or a bottle of perfume.
These items cost far less than a designer bag, but they still lift people’s mood.
This pattern is known as the lipstick effect.
It shows that people look for affordable pleasures even in hard times.
A small treat can make a difficult day feel a little brighter.
choices: the reasons designer bags become more expensive over time
why people buy small, affordable treats when the economy is bad
how cosmetic companies advertise their products online
the importance of saving money for the future
the history of lipstick as a popular fashion item
theme.explanation_ko: 경기가 나쁘면 비싼 물건은 줄이지만 립스틱·향수 같은 저렴한 즐거움은 계속 산다는 내용이므로 ②가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ① 가방 가격이 오르는 이유는 다루지 않는다. ③ 화장품 광고는 나오지 않는다. ④ 저축의 중요성이 아니라 작은 소비를 다룬다. ⑤ 립스틱의 역사는 나오지 않는다.

passage: People do not give up every pleasure when money is tight.
During an economic slump, they stop spending on costly products like designer bags.
However, they still want something to brighten their everyday lives.
So they turn to cheaper treats, such as a new lipstick or a small bottle of perfume.
These little purchases are easy on the wallet but still make them feel good.
This pattern is called the lipstick effect.
It reminds us that the wish to enjoy life does not disappear in hard times.
People simply find more affordable ways to satisfy it.
choices: 경기가 나빠지면 사람들은 모든 소비를 멈춘다.
비싼 제품일수록 사람들에게 더 큰 행복을 준다.
불황기에는 화장품 회사의 매출이 크게 줄어든다.
어려운 시기에도 사람들은 감당할 수 있는 작은 즐거움을 찾는다.
돈을 아끼려면 작은 사치품부터 줄여야 한다.
gist.explanation_ko: 돈이 부족해도 즐거움을 모두 포기하지 않고 더 저렴한 방법(립스틱·향수)으로 삶을 즐긴다는 내용이므로 ④가 요지이다.
gist.distractor_ko: ① 비싼 제품만 줄이고 작은 즐거움은 산다. ② 오히려 저렴한 물건이 기분을 좋게 한다. ③ 매출 이야기는 없다. ⑤ 작은 사치품은 오히려 계속 산다.

passage: When the economy slows down, many people cut back on big purchases.
They spend less money on expensive products such as designer bags.
Yet they do not stop treating themselves completely.
Instead, they spend a little on small luxuries such as a lipstick or a bottle of perfume.
These items cost far less than a designer bag, but they still lift people’s mood.
This pattern is known as the lipstick effect.
It shows that people look for affordable pleasures even in hard times.
A small treat can make a difficult day feel a little brighter.
choices: Small Treats in Hard Times: The Lipstick Effect
How to Choose the Right Lipstick
Why People Stop Shopping in a Crisis
title.explanation_ko: 어려운 시기에도 작은 사치(립스틱·향수)로 기분을 내는 립스틱 효과를 다루므로 ①이 제목으로 알맞다.
title.distractor_ko: ② 립스틱 고르는 법은 나오지 않는다. ③ 가방은 오히려 줄이는 소비이다. ④ 쇼핑을 멈추는 것이 아니라 작은 것을 산다. ⑤ 향수의 역사는 다루지 않는다.

passage: When times are hard, many families check their budgets carefully.
Big spending on designer bags or other expensive products is often the first thing to go.
But giving up every pleasure would make daily life feel gray.
That is why some people still pick up a new lipstick or a tiny bottle of perfume.
These products are fairly cheap, yet they make people feel happy.
For a small price, they open a small window of joy in a difficult week.
This is known as the lipstick effect.
People keep looking for affordable ways to enjoy their lives.
choices: a chance to earn extra money during a crisis
a way to save money for an expensive bag
a little happiness that an inexpensive item brings
a short break from shopping for cosmetics
a new store that sells only cheap products
implication.explanation_ko: 싼값에 립스틱·향수를 사서 힘든 한 주에 잠깐의 기쁨을 얻는다는 뜻이므로, 저렴한 물건이 주는 작은 행복인 ③이 알맞다.
implication.distractor_ko: ① 돈을 버는 이야기가 아니다. ② 비싼 가방은 오히려 포기한다. ④ 쇼핑을 쉬는 것이 아니라 작은 물건을 산다. ⑤ 실제 가게(window)를 뜻하지 않는다.

passage: The lipstick effect is a curious pattern in the economy.
When the economy is bad, people spend less money on expensive products.
However, they still want to enjoy small pleasures every day.
Instead of buying a designer bag, some people may buy a new lipstick.
Such products are fairly cheap, but they can make people to feel happy.
Even during difficult times, people still look for affordable ways to enjoy their lives.
grammar.explanation_ko: 사역동사 make 는 「make + 목적어 + 동사원형」 구조이므로 make people to feel 은 make people feel 이 되어야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 셀 수 없는 명사 money 앞이라 little 의 비교급 less. ② want 는 to부정사를 목적어로 취한다. ③ 전치사구 instead of 뒤에는 동명사 buying. ⑤ ways 를 꾸미는 형용사적 to부정사.

passage: The lipstick effect describes how people shop when the economy is weak.
In bad times, they spend less money on expensive items.
However, they completely give up small pleasures in their daily lives.
Instead of a designer bag, they may buy a new lipstick or a small perfume.
These items are relatively inexpensive, yet they lift people’s mood.
Even in difficult times, people look for affordable ways to enjoy life.
vocab.explanation_ko: However 로 앞 문장(비싼 물건에 돈을 덜 씀)과 대조되며, 뒤 문장에서 립스틱·향수를 산다고 했으므로 작은 즐거움을 ‘완전히 포기한다’가 아니라 ‘여전히 즐기고 싶어 한다’가 알맞다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ① 불황에는 비싼 물건에 돈을 ‘덜’ 쓴다. ③ 가방 ‘대신’ 립스틱을 산다. ④ 립스틱·향수는 비교적 ‘저렴하다’. ⑤ ‘감당할 만한’ 방법을 찾는다.

passage: When the economy is bad, people often feel they must save money.
They stop buying expensive products such as designer bags.
Still, they want small pleasures in their daily lives.
So they buy cheaper items like a new lipstick or a small perfume.
These products do not cost much, but they make people feel happy.
The lipstick effect shows that even in hard times, people ______________________.
They simply choose pleasures that fit their budget.
choices: stop spending money on anything they enjoy
buy more designer bags than before
save all of their money for the future
care less about how they look
still find affordable ways to enjoy their lives
blank.explanation_ko: 비싼 가방 대신 저렴한 립스틱·향수로 행복을 느낀다고 했으므로, 어려운 시기에도 사람들은 ‘삶을 즐길 감당할 만한 방법을 여전히 찾는다’.
blank.distractor_ko: ① 즐거움을 모두 포기하지 않는다. ② 비싼 가방은 오히려 사지 않는다. ③ 작은 것에는 돈을 쓴다. ④ 외모에 덜 신경 쓴다는 내용은 없다.

irrelevant.intro: The lipstick effect describes how people spend money when the economy is bad.
sentences: In hard times, people often spend less money on expensive products like designer bags.
However, they still want to enjoy small pleasures in their daily lives.
Some lipsticks are designed to last all day without fading.
So they buy relatively inexpensive items, such as a new lipstick or a small perfume.
These small purchases help them feel happy without spending too much.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: ③은 립스틱의 지속력(제품 성능)에 관한 내용으로, 불황기의 소비 심리를 다루는 글의 흐름과 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ① 비싼 제품 소비 감소, ② 작은 즐거움에 대한 욕구, ④ 저렴한 대체 구매, ⑤ 그 효과로 모두 흐름에 맞다.

order.given: The lipstick effect is an interesting economic phenomenon. When the economy is bad, people often spend less money on expensive products.

blocks.A: However, they do not give up every pleasure. They still want to enjoy small treats in their daily lives.
blocks.B: In this way, the lipstick effect shows that even in difficult economic times, people look for affordable ways to enjoy their lives.
blocks.C: For example, instead of buying an expensive designer bag, some people may buy a new lipstick or a small perfume. Such products are relatively inexpensive, but they make people feel happy.

order.explanation_ko: 비싼 제품에 돈을 덜 쓴다(주어진 글) → However 로 작은 즐거움은 원한다(A) → For example 로 립스틱·향수의 예(C) → In this way 로 결론(B) 순이다.
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 For example 은 (A)의 small treats 의 예시이므로 (A) 뒤에 오고, (B)의 In this way 는 앞의 내용을 모두 정리하므로 맨 끝이다.

insert.insert_sentence: These products are relatively inexpensive, but they can still make people feel happy.

passage_marked.text: The lipstick effect is a common pattern in hard economic times.
When the economy is bad, people spend less money on expensive products.
However, they still want to enjoy small pleasures in their daily lives.
For example, instead of a designer bag, some people buy a new lipstick or a small perfume.
That is why this pattern is named after the lipstick.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장의 These products 는 바로 앞의 립스틱·작은 향수를 가리키므로 ④에 들어간다. 뒤 문장의 That is why(그래서 립스틱의 이름이 붙었다)는 ‘저렴하지만 행복하게 해 준다’를 이유로 받는다.
insert.distractor_ko: ①②③ 앞에는 These products 가 가리킬 립스틱·향수가 아직 나오지 않았다. ⑤ That is why 의 이유가 빠진 채 결론이 먼저 나오게 된다.

passage: People do not give up every pleasure when money is tight.
During an economic slump, they stop spending on costly products like designer bags.
However, they still want something to brighten their everyday lives.
So they turn to cheaper treats, such as a new lipstick or a small bottle of perfume.
These little purchases are easy on the wallet but still make them feel good.
This pattern is called the lipstick effect.
It reminds us that the wish to enjoy life does not disappear in hard times.
People simply find more affordable ways to satisfy it.
summary.summary_template: In hard economic times, people spend less on __(A)__ products, but they still buy small, __(B)__ treats to enjoy their lives.
summary.explanation_ko: 비싼(expensive) 제품에는 돈을 덜 쓰지만 감당할 만한(affordable) 작은 즐거움은 계속 산다는 요약이다.
summary.distractor_ko: ② 싼 제품을 줄이는 것이 아니다. ③ 사치스러운 것이 아니라 저렴한 것을 산다. ④ 줄이는 것은 필수품이 아니라 비싼 제품이다. ⑤ 저렴한 제품을 줄이고 쓸모없는 것을 사는 내용이 아니다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.explanation_ko: want 는 to부정사를 목적어로 취하므로 want to enjoy, 부사 still 은 일반동사 want 앞에 둔다.
writing.answer: However, they still want to enjoy small pleasures in their daily lives.
writing.ko_prompt: 하지만 그들은 여전히 일상생활에서 작은 즐거움을 누리고 싶어 한다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.
writing.explanation_ko: 「make + 목적어 + 동사원형」(make people feel)과 「feel + 형용사」(feel happy), 부사 relatively 가 형용사 inexpensive 를 꾸민다.
writing.answer: These products are relatively inexpensive, but they can make people feel happy.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 제품들은 비교적 저렴하지만, 사람들을 행복하게 느끼도록 해 줄 수 있다.

writing.question: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.
writing.context: For example, ___________ of buying an expensive designer bag, some people may buy a new lipstick or a small perfume.
writing.explanation_ko: instead of + 동명사 ‘~하는 대신에’. 본문 4번 문장이다.

writing.question: 다음 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.explanation_ko: shows that + 주어 + 동사, that절 안에 부사구 even during difficult economic times 가 끼어 있고 ways to enjoy 는 형용사적 to부정사이다.
writing.en_prompt: The lipstick effect shows that even during difficult economic times, people still look for affordable ways to enjoy their lives.
writing.answer: 립스틱 효과는 경제적으로 어려운 시기에도 사람들이 여전히 자신의 삶을 즐길 수 있는 감당할 만한(저렴한) 방법을 찾는다는 것을 보여 준다.

writing.question: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말을 본문에서 찾아 각각 한 단어로 쓰시오.
writing.summary: When the economy is bad, people spend __(A)__ money on expensive products, but they still look for __(B)__ ways to enjoy their lives.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문 2번 문장의 spend less money, 6번 문장의 affordable ways to enjoy their lives 에서 찾는다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 이 글의 주제문을 영어로 쓰시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 글의 주제를 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
conditions: the lipstick effect 와 affordable 을 반드시 포함할 것
writing.answer: The lipstick effect shows that people buy affordable small pleasures even when the economy is bad.
writing.explanation_ko: 불황이라는 상황과 감당할 만한 작은 즐거움을 산다는 행동을 한 문장에 담는다.
